# CI-only resolver constraints for install-monorepo-packages.
#
# kubernetes 37.0.2 (via chromadb) requires python-dateutil>=3, while every
# botocore 1.43.x (via litellm -> boto3) requires python-dateutil<3. pip's
# backtracker then walks botocore and pandas down to pandas 1.4.4 (an sdist
# that cannot build) instead of stepping kubernetes back to 37.0.1. Pinning the
# bound botocore already enforces lets pip reject kubernetes 37.0.2 at once.
# Remove once botocore supports python-dateutil 3.
python-dateutil<3
